plan.summary: This 4-week block builds a base for boxing off-camp with two focused sessions each week using bodyweight-only work. Week 1 establishes baseline strength on the two main lifts so future progress is easier to track, and the main training starts in Week 2. The block emphasizes lower-body and upper-body strength, simple explosive work, trunk strength, and low-equipment conditioning without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic strength, power, trunk control, and aerobic work capacity with simple bodyweight movements done well.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress harder bodyweight variations, raise density carefully, and keep power output sharp.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength qualities while shifting more of the work toward faster, cleaner sport-relevant output.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Land quietly and reset between reps. Jump as high and fast as you can.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if space is tight or jumping skill is limited.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump to Low Stable Surface
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if you have a safe landing surface and can step down under control.

exercises.name: 1b. Plyometric Push-Up
exercises.notes: Explode off the floor with crisp reps. Stop before speed drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if full plyometric push-ups are too aggressive.

substitutionOptions.name: Hand-Release Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need a simpler explosive push variation.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.reps: max clean reps leaving 1 rep in reserve
exercises.notes: Warm up with easy sets, then perform one hard clean set to establish your baseline for future progress. Stop when body position or rep quality breaks.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best clean rep total from the top set.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then do one hard top set of clean push-ups stopping with about 1 rep left. Log the rep total to establish your baseline for future progress.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if full push-ups are not yet consistent. Keep the same body angle each time you retest.

exercises.name: 3. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Lower under control and drive up hard. Keep hips high and head moving slightly forward.

substitutionOptions.name: Decline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if pike position is uncomfortable.

substitutionOptions.name: Wall Handstand Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if pressing strength is limited and you need a safer vertical-pattern option.

exercises.name: 4. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Keep ribs down and body straight. Do not let the hips sag.

exercises.name: 5. Shadow Boxing Aerobic Rounds
exercises.notes: Keep the pace smooth and technical. Breathe through the work and stay relaxed.

endurancePrescription.target: Build boxing-specific aerobic rhythm without extra impact
endurancePrescription.notes: Use light combinations, stance switches, and steady movement rather than hard flurries.

exercises.name: 1a. Squat Jump

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if squat jumps feel awkward.

exercises.name: 1b. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Cover a manageable distance and stick the landing before the next rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Lateral Bound to Stick
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simpler side-to-side power option.

exercises.name: 2. Split Squat
exercises.reps: max clean reps leaving 1 rep in reserve
exercises.notes: Warm up with easy sets, then perform one hard clean set per side to establish your baseline. Keep the torso tall and full control on every rep.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log the best clean rep total for each side from the top set.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then do one hard top set per side stopping with about 1 rep left. Log the rep total for each side to establish your baseline for future progress.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if split squats bother the knees or balance is poor.

exercises.name: 3. Single-Leg Hip Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through the heel and finish with the glute. Do not arch the low back.

exercises.name: 4. Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Exhale fully as the leg and arm reach. Keep the low back flat to the floor.

exercises.name: 5. Circuit Conditioning
exercises.notes: Move steadily and keep technique clean. This should build work capacity, not turn into a sloppy race.
